comment: Careers/about pages for Basecamp and its former name 37signals. A deliberate anti-intensity 'calm company' (Rework, 'It Doesn't Have to Be Crazy at Work') — a useful counterpoint to the Netflix performance-culture lineage. Seed patterns; refine after `discover`.
comment_patterns: Refined after discover: kept the three content-bearing patterns. Dropped 37signals.com/careers and basecamp.com/careers (0 captures) and basecamp.com/jobs (1 thin capture) — Basecamp moved culture/hiring copy to /about after the 2014 rebrand; jobs live under the 37signals era. Adjacent culture pages added via link expansion (M8): /handbook (the employee handbook incl. benefits-and-perks) and /guides (how-we-communicate, how-we-make-decisions).

patterns.era_hint: manifesto-era homepage, numbered 'signals' philosophy (pre-2005 archaeology 2026-07-18; max_year bounds out post-2004 product marketing)
